const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 -B -c 'exec("""import json, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, "tools")
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
manifest = load_manifest(version="tome-1.7.6")
loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(manifest))
head_raw = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", "HEAD:tome-orcs.lua"])
work_raw = Path("tome-orcs.lua").read_bytes()
head = list(loader.load_bytes(head_raw, logical_path="tome-orcs.lua").translations)
work = list(loader.load_bytes(work_raw, logical_path="tome-orcs.lua").translations)
assert len(head) == len(work) == 3904, (len(head), len(work))
def stable(r):
    return {k:v for k,v in r.items() if k not in {"line", "target"}}
def ident(r):
    return (r.get("section"), r.get("source"), r.get("source_tag"), json.dumps(r.get("args_order"), sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False), json.dumps(r.get("special"), sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False))
changes = []
for index, (before, after) in enumerate(zip(head, work)):
    assert stable(before) == stable(after), ("non-target-field-change", index, stable(before), stable(after))
    if before.get("target") != after.get("target"):
        changes.append((ident(before), before.get("target"), after.get("target")))
ws = json.loads(Path(".ai/task/repair-w44-20260927/WORKSET.json").read_text())
expected = {(item["section"], item["source"], item.get("source_tag"), json.dumps(None, sort_keys=True), json.dumps(None, sort_keys=True)): item for item in ws["items"]}
assert len(changes) == 24, len(changes)
assert len(expected) == 24, len(expected)
assert {x[0] for x in changes} == set(expected), ({x[0] for x in changes} - set(expected), set(expected) - {x[0] for x in changes})
for key, before, after in changes:
    assert before == expected[key]["target_preimage"], expected[key]["entry_revision_identity"]
print("translations=3904; changed_targets=24; workset_match=24/24; non_target_field_changes=0; every preimage matched WORKSET.json")
""")'","workdir":"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation","yield_time_ms":30000,"max_output_tokens":12000,"sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"允许我运行只读的 LuaJIT HEAD/工作树语义比较，确认恰好24个工作集 target 变化且其他字段未变吗？"}); text(JSON.stringify(r))
